evals.name: clear-small-story
evals.prompt: Please estimate ORFI-61104 using planning poker and add story points to it.
evals.expected_output: Proposes 2 or 3 points, uses calibration data (cites at least one of ORFI-61082 / ORFI-60912 / ORFI-60845), asks for user confirmation before writing, does not call jira_update_issue without confirmation.

evals.name: bug-refusal
evals.prompt: Can you add a story point estimate to ORFI-61201?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes Bug issue type, refuses to assign story points, explains why bugs don't get points, calls jira_add_comment noting the policy, does NOT call jira_update_issue.

evals.name: too-big
evals.prompt: Size ORFI-61310 with story points please.
evals.expected_output: Refuses because work is 13+ (too big, cap is 8), flags this to user, suggests 2+ concrete splits for breaking the story down, emits NO numeric estimate, does NOT call jira_update_issue.

evals.name: ambiguous-spike
evals.expected_output: Recognizes ambiguity (doc + POC deliverable on a Task type), asks the user whether to treat as spike or regular story rather than guessing.

evals.name: clear-spike
evals.prompt: Please put a planning-poker estimate on ORFI-61520.
evals.expected_output: Proposes '?' (spike value), asks for confirmation, handles the numeric-only Story Points field by either writing ? if accepted or explaining the fallback (leave blank + add explanatory comment).
